summary: Today’s PaymentsDive recap: 8 new stories, with focus on regulation, product + fintech innovation.

articles.title: Fed proposes stablecoin rules
articles.description: The regulations aim to make these digital assets “foster payments improvements that benefit households and businesses,” Federal Reserve Gov. Michael Barr said.

articles.title: Payment revenue growth to slow
articles.description: The rate of payments-related revenue growth in North America, and globally, will slow in the next four years, a major consulting firm predicts.

articles.title: Stripe alums spark new payments plays
articles.description: The digital processor has become a founders’ factory with former employees seeding startups across the financial technology field.

articles.title: Turning audience data into an intent channel
articles.description: Turn financial data into an intent channel that creates value across the commerce ecosystem.

articles.title: How embedded finance is redefining the role of SaaS platforms
articles.description: Embedded finance is the new SaaS moat. Learn how to turn payments into a core revenue engine.

articles.title: Kroger’s AI focus is on ‘flexibility and control’
articles.description: From bridging the digital and physical shopping worlds to further ramping effective personalization, the grocer’s chief digital officer delved into the company’s priorities.

articles.title: FIDO wrestles with agentic trust
articles.description: The industry consortium and payments players are considering standards for agentic commerce, particularly for verifying identity.

articles.title: ACH use rises for B2B payments
articles.description: The automated clearing house payments have multiplied to overtake paper checks as the most popular form of business-to-business payments, according to a new Federal Reserve report.
